_doc: Server set for `install-linux.sh --desktop-chat-mcp`: merged into ~/.config/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json under mcpServers. A leading ~ or ${HOME} is expanded to the real home directory at install time. Only stdio servers fit this file (it has no headersHelper), so exa, jina, spider and context7 (HTTP) are not here; add them as connectors in the app. neural-memory is left out on purpose: it has one SQLite writer owned by the delegator agent. No secrets live here: bin/mcp-run reads ~/.claude/stack.env itself. Names are prefixed c101- so they never collide with entries you wrote by hand.
